live_matches.description: Czechia take on Guatemala in an international friendly as both sides look to refine their preparations and build confidence through a competitive test. Expect an intriguing encounter, with Czechia aiming to control possession and dictate the tempo, while Guatemala seek to challenge through energy, organization, and quick attacking transitions. Catch all the action from the International Friendlies, LIVE on Sony LIV.
